## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal changed faster than the configured percentage relative to its own recent history. Speed of degradation, not absolute level.

Query:

```
pct_change(avg(last_15m),last_4h):sum:datadog.estimated_usage.metrics.custom{__SCOPE__}.as_rate() < -40
```

**Design note.** A 40% collapse in custom-metric ingest means a large part of the estate has gone dark. This is the highest-leverage monitor in the repository: it is what stops "all green" from meaning "all blind".

## Impact

Customers are affected now, or a mission-critical capability is unavailable. Treat as an outage until proven otherwise.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-platform-services`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-major-incident` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `create_incident`, `page_incident_commander`, `open_bridge`, `post_status_update`.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `observability-platform` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P1 — ack within 5 minutes, escalate at 10.
